verdict.rationale: Reducto's official MCP server (local and hosted) lets agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients classify, parse, extract, split and edit documents from natural-language requests. Several endpoints also take natural language directly: split sections, classify/route categories, and PDF/DOCX edit instructions. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface (in Studio or a chat UI) rather than reliance on third-party agent clients; Extract is schema-driven rather than plain natural language; no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation via MCP.
